title: Copilot preToolUse hook decision
description: The decision object a GitHub Copilot CLI `preToolUse` hook returns to allow/deny/ask a tool call (fail-closed on error). Schema from SPIKE-1 (docs/spikes/spike1-provider-contract.md §4.4) / docs.github.com hooks-configuration. This is the Copilot-side mechanism for the J7 permission flow (FR-AGENT-3); the Claude side uses `--permission-prompt-tool` targeting the `permission_request` MCP tool instead (mcp-tool-call.schema.json).
